source.title: Essential Fashion Tips For Short Men
source.author: FashionBeans

tips.text: If you're short, have one pair of trousers hemmed to the perfect length and use it as the template for hemming every future pair.
tips.why: Off-the-rack trousers are usually too long and pool at the ankle.

tips.text: To look taller, wear your top and trousers in the same or very similar shades.
tips.why: Low contrast creates one unbroken line that lengthens the body.

tips.text: Wear trousers sitting a couple of inches below the navel and tuck in your shirt or knit.
tips.why: A higher waistline makes the legs look longer.

tips.text: Short men should choose slim or tapered cuts over baggy or boxy ones.
tips.why: Excess fabric swamps a small frame and makes it look smaller.

tips.text: Keep trousers plain and neutral and put pattern and detail on your top half.
tips.why: Detail near the face draws the eye upward; loud trousers pull it down.

tips.text: Short men suit a slim suit with narrow lapels and the jacket button placed slightly above the navel.
tips.why: One column of colour and a high button point lengthen the body.

tips.text: For extra height, pick chunky-soled trainers, commando-soled shoes or work boots rather than Cuban heels.
tips.why: They add height quietly; obvious heels can look desperate.

tips.text: Choose shirts that end around the hips rather than long, boxy ones.
tips.why: A shorter hem shows more leg; boxy cuts look dumpy.

tips.text: Favour cropped jackets such as a Harrington or bomber, and keep overcoats above mid-thigh.
tips.why: Long coats swamp a short frame like a cape.
